content: Human-labeling session — lh-recovery-after-mid-game-loss:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, you hold a forward Soviet base at the middle of the map — Construction Yard, Ore Refinery, Power Plant, an Ore Truck and two rifle defenders, with a small ore patch beside it. You also have a parked Mobile Construction Vehicle and a second Power Plant at a deep-west safe zone, well clear of the east-edge ingress lane. A light enemy ground rush is closing from the east, and scout reports warn of follow-on waves through the run. Cash: $1600. Win bar: a Construction Yard AND an Ore Refinery, both standing inside the deep-west disc (radius 8 around the safe zone), AND at least one of your units alive, within about fifty turns. Total loss of every Construction Yard you own is an immediate fail.
